itinerary.title: Travelling by Bus — Mumbai to Hosapete
itinerary.description: Board AC Sleeper Bus from your nearest pickup point. Overnight journey towards Hosapete. Reach Hosapete by approximately 6:00 AM. Freshen up at common dormitory rooms, have breakfast and proceed to the day's sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing — Day 1
itinerary.description:
Begin with the majestic Underground Shiva Temple. Then witness the marvelous Lotus Mahal, the gigantic Elephant Stable, the Queen's Bath Complex, and end with the monolithic Nandi. Check in at hotel. Dinner and overnight stay.

Note: Sequence of sightseeing places may vary depending on any unavoidable situations or crowd.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing — Day 2
itinerary.description:
Start with Kondaram Temple, then Sugreev Caves, King's Balance, the iconic Stone Chariot, and Vijay Vitthal Temple. Evening: Coracle Ride (at your own expense) and shopping at Hampi streets. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

Note: Sequence of sightseeing places may vary depending on any unavoidable situations or crowd.

itinerary.title: Hampi Sightseeing — Day 3 & Return Journey
itinerary.description:
Visit Virupaksha Temple, Kadalekalu Ganesha, Sasivekalu Ganesha, Badavalinga Temple (Hampi's Largest Lingam), and Ugra Narasimha Temple. After sightseeing, board the bus for return journey to Mumbai.

Note: Sequence of sightseeing places may vary depending on any unavoidable situations or crowd.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai & Pune
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by approximately 6:00 AM and Pune by approximately 9:00 AM. Return home with sweet memories!
